name.en-US: Essay on Beatification, Canonization and the Processes of the Congregation of Rites
name.pt-BR: Ensaio sobre a Beatificação, a Canonização e os Processos da Congregação dos Ritos

description.en-US: An Essay on Beatification, Canonization, and the Processes of the Congregation of Rites (1848): Faber's account, written for the Earl and Countess of Shrewsbury, of how the Church examines the cause of a servant of God: the stages of the process, the roles of the Congregation of Rites and the devil's advocate, the proofs of virtues and miracles, and the meaning of beatification and canonization.
description.pt-BR: Um Ensaio sobre a Beatificação, a Canonização e os Processos da Congregação dos Ritos (1848): a exposição de Faber, escrita para os Condes de Shrewsbury, de como a Igreja examina a causa de um servo de Deus: as etapas do processo, o papel da Congregação dos Ritos e do advogado do diabo, as provas das virtudes e dos milagres e o sentido da beatificação e da canonização.

en-US.editor: Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1848)

sources.edition: Essay on Beatification, Canonization and the Processes of the Congregation of Rites (London: Richardson and Son, 1848), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The dedication and the essay; the publisher's catalogue is dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
